Definition: adverb from a compound of G4183 and G5158; in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form:--in divers manners.
BiblicalUsage: Polytropos means in many ways, in divers manners, and it pairs with the word before it in Hebrews. God spoke at sundry times and in divers manners, through prophets and visions and dreams, before he spoke finally by his Son.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the many ways God spoke all point one direction, and they make sense only when I read them in the light of Christ.
